tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las/ sna tshogs yum dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// lag pa dag ni rab 'phyang rkang pa'i pad+ma mnyam pa dag dang srog gi rlung ni 'gog bya ste// ji srid lus ni sa la rab tu lhung bar ma gyur pa dang tsha ba dag ni grol ba yang*// yang dang yang du ting nge 'dzin la'o 'chi ba'i 'jigs par byed pa'i tsher ma can ni nges 'joms te// snying ga'i pad+mar zla ba'i gzugs can dri med ri bong can mtshungs sna tshogs yum ni bsgoms pas so/

122 /sran chung btags nas 'thungs pas tsha bas rnam par bsnun pa'i mi rnams kyi ni tsher ma 'joms par byed// tsha ba'i mthar ni thod pa brdar ba mi bskyod bsres pa yis kyang 'jigs par byed pa 'phrog pa ste// sngags kyang chu me rlung rnams dag gi sngon du oṃ yig dang ni badz+ra snga ma dag dpe gcig la/ sngon ma can gyi zhes pa'ang gda'/ gi ming*// de nyid kyis ni bsrung bar bya ste mgo mgrin snying ga lte ba gsang ba la sogs rnams su'o/ 123 /zhes bya ba ni bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi nang gi le'u las so// da ni lag pa zhes pa la sogs pas rdo rje'i tsher ma 'brum bu nye bar zhi bar byed pa gsungs te/ 'dir gang gi tshe sdig pa'i nad 'brum chen kyi nye bar 'tshe ba byung na de'i tshe dang por tsha ba skye bar 'gyur zhing lag pa dang rkang pa'i tshigs rnams gdung bar 'gyur te/ mgo bo'ang gdung bar 'gyur ro// mtshan nyid 'di shes nas ting nge 'dzin la dmigs par bya'o// de la 'di ni cho ga ste bug pa med pa'i khyim du tsha ba skyes pa rab tu zhugs nas lag pa gnyis po dag ni brla'i mthar thug par rab tu 'phyang bar bya zhing rkang pa'i pad+ma mnyam pa dag byas te/ srog gi rlung ni 'gog pa bum pa can bya'o// ji srid lus ni sa la rab tu lhung ste 'gyel bar ma gyur pa de srid du ste/ tsha ba'i nad kyi sa la rab tu lhung bar 'gyur ro// des na ma lhung ba'i bar du yang dang yang du srog rtsol bya'o zhes pa ni nges pa'o// ji srid tsha ba dag ni grol bar yang ma gyur pa de srid du bya ste/ tsha ba grol bar gyur na mi bya'o zhes pa ni nges pa'o// yang dang yang du ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas 'chi ba'i 'jigs par byed pa'i tsher ma can ni nges par 'joms te/ snying ga'i pad+mar zla ba'i gzugs can dri med ri bong can mtshungs sna tshogs yum ni bsgoms pas so// zhes pa ni srog rtsol gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje

skyil krung gis// pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa ste pad+ma dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag go zhes pa ni sdig pa'i nad nye bar zhi ba'i nges pa'o// da ni sdig pa'i nad nye bar zhi ba'i don du sman gsungs te/ 'dir gang gi tshe sdig pa'i nad kyi mtshan ma tsha ba skyes pa dang rkang pa'i tshigs rnams gdung bar gyur na/ de'i tshe sran chung phye mar/ btags nas chu grang mo dang sbyar ba yis tsha bas rnam par bsnun pa'i mi rnams la byin na tsher ma 'joms par byed do// de bzhin du tsha ba'i mthar ni zhes pa nyin zhag gsum pa la tsher ma 'thon pa'i dus su sdig pa'i nad kyis shi ba'i thod pa ste ma rnyed na ji ltar rnyed pa bdar nas mi bskyod bsres pa'i skyes pa'i thod pa bdar ba skyes pa dang*/ bud med kyi thod pa bud med kyis 'thungs shing*/ ma rnyed na ji ltar rnyed pa 'thungs pas 'jigs par byed pa'i tsher ma can 'phrog ste/ tsha ba'i mthar thod pa ji ltar rnyed pas so zhes pa ni nges pa'o// 'dir sran chung la sogs pa la mngon par bsngags pa'i slad du sngags su 'gyur ro// de yang dang por oṃ yig ste/ sngags kyang chu me rlung rnams dag gi sngon du oṃ yig ces pas thog mar oṃ gyi yi ge chu zhes pa ni pa sde'i yi ge gnyis pa chu'i khams te pha'o// me zhes pa 'og tu ra'o// steng du e yig ste/ chu me rlung 'di dag rnams gcig pa nyid ni phreṃ rjes su nga ro nam mkha' thams cad la khyab pa nyid kyi phyir ro// badz+ra snga ma kaṇ+ḍa ka rnams kyi ming ngo*// de nyid kyis ni bsrung bar bya ste/ sran chung la sogs pa la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa ji lta ba de bzhin nyid du de nyid kyis bsrung ba ste/ mgo mgrin snying ga lte ba gsang ba dang sogs pa'i sgras gtsug tor te/ gnas drug po sngags chus byug 'di rnams su thun gsum du bsrung bar bya'o zhes pa ni nges pa'o// 'dir sngags ni/

oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ badz+ra kāṇ+ḍa kā na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gzhan srung ba'i don du lha sbyin gyi ste gang bsrung ba de'i ming gzhug shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes pa ni nges pa'o// 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi ste nad yams la sogs pa/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad las bdag dang gzhan bsrung ba la dran par bya'o// zhes pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi nges pa'o// sngags 'dis lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i sran chung chu grang mos btags pa btung bar sbyin zhing*/ tsha bas shi ba'i thod pa mi bskyod pas btags pa sbyin no// 'byung pos zin pa la tsha ba gsum dang bcas pa mi bskyod pas btags nas sbyin te sdig pa'i nad nye bar zhi ba'i nges pa'o// zhes bya ba ni 'grel chen las bu ston rin po che'i gsung mchod bcas/ so// ༈ /sna tshogs yum gyi 'brum srung bzhugs so// na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs yum bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun la sogs pa ci rigs par byas pa'i rjes su/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde dang ldan na dga'/ chags ldang med pa'i ngang du btang snyoms par gyur cig oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rgya mtsho chen po de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid phreṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/

g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas ut+pal dkar po'i rtsa ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ snyan gyi thad sor kha phye ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhīs rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dgug gzhug bcing mnyes ro mnyam par byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsgoms pa'i thugs kar phreṃ/ de'i mtha' ma nas phar/ oṃ phreṃ bi sna tshogs yum/ shwa mā taḥ badz+ra rdo rje tsher ma rnams kāṇ+ḍa kān nā gzhom du gsol/ sha ya nā gzhom du gsol/ sha ya/ ma bdag gi ma shān+tiṃ zhi bar ku ru mdzod mdzod/ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad de/ stong rtsa'am brgya rtsa'am nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs par bzlas pa'i bar smra bcad bya/ mthar rlung bum pa can bdun bsgom/ de nas sngags bgrangs pa'i mchil ma lag pa la bskus te kha dang spyi bo la sogs pa'i lus kyi sgo dgu la nan cher byug dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas gtsug tor te gnas drug tu yang sngags chus byug go/ yang mchil ma de lus ril po la yang byugs la nad dang rims thams cad kyis mi tshugs par bsgoms la/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la nad dang rims dang khyad par du rdo rje'i tsher ma 'brum bu la sogs pas mi tshugs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab la/ bsod nams 'di yis rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces dge ba bsngo/ sna tshogs yum bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsgom/ de rnams nangs par snga bar langs te mi gzhan dang skad ma 'dres pa'i gong du/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas sna tshogs yum lus la thim pa'i bar snga dro'i dus su ma chag par byas na/

rdo rje'i tsher mas mi tshugs shing*/ rims gzhan gyis kyang mi tshugs so// gal te byung na'ang nad des mi 'chi bar nyams su myong ba yin no// rje btsun ma sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub thabs bu ston gyis bkod pa'o// shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ /sna tshogs yum gyi sgom bzlas srung ba dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgom bzlas kyi sgo nas 'brum nad dang*/ yams kyi nad zhi bar 'dod pas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed byas te/ skad cig tsam gyis rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba dang*/ de dag gi steng du sna tshogs yum sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bsnams pa gsal bar bsgoms la/ oṃ phreṃ bi kye sna tshogs yum/ shwa mā taḥ badz+ra kāṇ+ḍa rdo rje'i tsher ma rnams/ kā na nā nyams par mdzod/ sha ya nā nyams par mdzod/ sha ya/ ma ma bdag gi zhi bar mdzod mdzod/ shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa mi'i tshig gis bar ma chod par brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ mchil ma khong du mid cing spyi bo'i gtsug dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga dang*/ lte ba dang*/ gsang ba ste gnas drug tu sngags lan bdun bzlas pa'i chus/ snga dro dang*/ gung dang*/ dgong mo ste thun gsum du byug cing*/ srung ba ji ltar nus par bsgom/ bzlas pa la brtson par byas na/ 'brum nag gi nad dang yams nad dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba la sogs pa srung bar 'gyur ro/ 'di'i bdag bskyed snying gar bskyed par bshad kyang*/ rang nyid bskyed pas chog dar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhi zhing sgeg pa/ 'dzum dang ldan par bsgom/ mdun bskyed mchod pa nas/

oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed mdzad ma// skye ba dang ni 'jig pa spangs// kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mdzad// sna tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rjes gnang gi chings sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin no/ gzhan srung bar 'dod na ni/ ma ma zhes pa'i gnas su bsgrub bya'i ming gzhug par bya ste 'di khyad par ro// sngon du yams 'og tu chug pas 'brum nag byung srid na/ nye bar zhi ba'i don du sman gsungs te/ sdig pa'i nad kyi mtshan mar tsha ba skyes pa dang*/ lag pa dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ sked pa'i tshigs rnams gdung bar 'gyur zhing*/ mgo bo'am na bar 'gyur na/ de'i tshe sran chung phye mar btags pa thur mgo gang tsam chu grangs mo la sbyar nas/ gong gi sngags bdun bzlas te/ skya nad las ma grol gyi bar du nyin re bzhin sbyin par bya'o// de nas zhag gsum mam lnga'i mthar/ 'brum pa phyed tsam thon pa'i dus su/ rang gi dri chu la 'brum nag gis shi ba'i thod pa bdar ba skyes pa la bud med kyi 'thungs shing*/ ma rnyed na ji ltar rnyed pa la gong gi sngags lan bdun gyis bsngags pa 'thungs pas 'brum pa'i nad bde bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni 'phul sman zhes grags pa de nyid yin no// 'byung pos zin pa la ni pi pi ling*/ na le sham/ sga skya gsum mnyam du btags nas dri chu la sbyar ba byin na zhi bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa 'di ni dus 'khor rgyud 'grel las gsungs pas the tshom mi bya'o// rgyud 'grel las btsun pa chos rwa ston pa grags dpal bzang pos phyung nas go sla bar bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha gsum gyi nang nas sna tshogs yum dkar mo'i sgrub skor rjes gnang dang bcas pa phan bde'i mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi lha gsum gyi nang nas bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum dkar mo bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/

dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan bdun la sogs pa'i ci rigs pa byas pa'i rjes su sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring mtha' dang bral ba'i chags sdang med pa'i ngang du sems btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rgya mtsho chen po/ de'i dbus su pam̐ la pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid phreṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas ut+pal dkar po'i rtsa ba thugs kar bsnams pa snyan gyi thad sor kha phye ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar po'i na bzas bklubs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhī/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pas dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od rigs bdag 'od dpag med dmar po 'god pa rgyud don no/ dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs kar phreṃ/ de'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon spyi dang khyad par rdo rje'i tsher ma la sogs pa'i rims thams cad zhi bar byas/

tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim par gyur/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ badz+ra kāṇ+ḍa kā na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la nad dang rims dang khyad par rdo rje'i tsher ma la sogs pas mi tshugs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bsod nams 'di yis rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces dge ba bsngos la thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum dkar mo'i sgo nas 'brum bu'i nad srung ba dang gso ba gnyis las/ dang po srung ba ni tho rangs snga bar langs te mi gzhan dang skad ma 'dres pa'i gong du skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar bstan pa bzhin nyams su blangs la sngags stong rtsa'am/ brgya rtsa'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig nyung mthar byas pa mi tshig gis bar ma chod par byas te bzla/ mthar rlung bum pa can bdun bsgom/ de nas sngags bgrangs pa'i mchil ma lag pa la bskus te kha dang spyi bo/ sna gnyis/ rna bar gnyis/ lte ba/ gsang gnas kyi bu ga 'og sgo ste lus kyi sgo dgu dang*/ yang dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas/ gtsug tor te gnas drug tu sngags chus byug yang sngags bgrangs pa'i mchil ma dang rang gi dri chu bsres te lus ril po la'ang byugs la nad dang rims thams cad kyis mi tshugs par bsgom/ dge ba bsngos la sna tshogs yum bdag nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ rim pa de snga dro'i dus su ma chag par byas na 'brum bu'i nad dang rims thams cad kyis mi tshugs so// gal te las dbang gis rims nad byung na'ang nad des mi 'chi bar nyams su myong ba yin no// de lta bu nyams su len mi nus pa gzhan srung na ma nu khrag can gyi nang khrag la sngags stong rtsa bzlas te/

bsgrub pa sngon du btang*/ las la sbyor dus sngags yig 'bru dgu pa 'di sum brgya bzlas la btab/ badz+ra ha ra badz+ra na hi dza/ bsrung bya'i smin mtshams su srin lag gi nang khrag blangs la thig le bya/ sngags ring ba brgya rtsa bzlas la gnas drug tu phus btab ste/ der 'brum bu shar na zla ba gsum thub bo// rtsa sngags/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ badz+ra kāṇ+ḍa kā na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ na ma shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i ma ma zhes pa'i tshab tu bsrung bya'i ming dang*/ mjug tu 'brum bu'i nad thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes bris pa la shu dag gla rtsi/ yung ba gsum byug srad bu dmar po'i srung skud la dkris shing la cha'am dar gyis dril te sna tshogs yum du bskyed nas 'od zhu dang rab gnas byas la bsrung bya'i mgul du gdags so// nad 'di sdig pa'i nad yin pas srung ba de lta bus dam tshig la gnas shing brtul zhugs gtsang ba rnams srung thub pa yin gyi/ de las bzlog pa rnams ni re zhig srung bar mi nus mod/ nad skya yang ba tsam gyi phan yon mi bslu ba yin gsungs so// gnyis pa 'brum bu'i nad byung na gso ba'i tshul la/ skya nad kyi dus mun khang shin tu dro bar zhugs te mnyam pa'i stabs kyis 'greng la lag pa gnyis thur du dpyangs te snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du phreṃ dkar po'i 'phro 'du las sna tshogs yum sngar bzhin bskyed/ de'i 'od kyis nad thams cad phyir bud de ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas thon 'gro bar bsams te rlung bum pa can bzung la rlung sbyor tsha ba las grol grol gyi bar bya/ de ltar mi nus na'ang spyod lam ci bder 'dug ste snying gar sna tshogs yum bskyed/ de'i thugs kar sngags phreng bkod/ 'od zer gyis nad phyir dbyung ba'i dmigs pa byas nas sngags bzlas so// rang shi'i thod pa bdar ba rang gi dri chu'am chang la gla rtsi btab ste sngags bzlas pas phul re btang*/

sran chung btags pa'i sran phye chu bskol grangs zhag tu ma lon pa la btag nas skom du cung zad bsten/ des nges par phan no// shin tu lci ba'i rigs la sman dpyad kyang bya ste/ de la ba spu'i khung bu dbye zhing nad smin par byed pa dang*/ 'brum bu phyir phul ba dang*/ khong shor ram nang du ldog pa phyir drangs pa dang*/ rjes bcad pa'i thabs dang bzhi las/ dang po mgo bo dang tshigs bzhi na zhing grang shum byed pa sogs nad rtag langs pa dang*/ sman sle tres cha gcig a ru ra/ ba ru ra/ skyu ru ra gsum po cha gnyis/ tig ta cha phyed/ ba sha ka cha phyed/ li ga dur cha phyed dang bcas pa'i sle tres bdun thang du grags pa'i bsdus thang tsha mo btang zhing drod la sgor/ rngul dbyung zhing rlung ma shor ba shin tu dro bar bya/ mig dang gre ba la 'brum bu srung ba'i phyir nad pa'i khams dang mthun pa'i dar ram ras kyi khud du/ gur gum/ gla rtsi/ rgya ru/ nas nag gi 'bru lnga'am bdun la/ bdud kyi bu mo thib long swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags sum brgya btab pa'i thum bu ske la btags/ gnyis pa thor pa snga ma mgo 'bur ba'i tshe phul sman/ tsan+dan dkar po zho gang*/ cu gang*/ gur gum/ gi hang*/ gla rtsi rnams zho phyed re/ spal rgyab/ mdung rtse/ gangs thig mtshal/ dngul chu mu zis bshigs pa/ a ru ra/ stag sha tshwa la btul ma rnams zho phyed re/ rang shi'i thod pa btsa' ma zho gang*/ 'dzin pa zho gang dang bcas pa'i sman sna bco lnga pho rlung las che ba'i rigs dang rgan byis sogs la thun phran re chang gis phul/ dar ma mkhris shas che ba'i rigs la chu skol gyis phul te yang yang btung la gtong ba man ngag yin/ sman thams cad la sna tshogs yum gyi sngags bzlas pa btab pas shin tu zab/ gsum pa 'brum bu khong du shor ba'am/ nang du log na gong gi sman rnams las mtshal dang*/ 'dzin pa bungs bskyed la ba ru ra'i chig thang gis phul te btang zhing*/ rdo sbyor dang rtsi sman gyi khyad par sman gyi gzhung las bshad pa'ang 'di skabs bsten/

'brum bu thon nas rnag tu 'gug pa la/ sbal rgyab/ gangs thig gla rtsi/ bdud rtsi 'o ma rnams thun tshad re sbyar ba'i steng du shing kun thun gnyis bsnan pa chang ngam/ chu skol gyis phul la ji tsam 'os pa btang rnag tu zhugs nas skem pa'i thabs su spos dkar mer bsreg pa'i dud pas yang yang bdug bzhi pa rjes bcad pa ni 'brum bu'i rnag rdol nas rlan che zhing tsha ba skye ba'i dus su sha ru'i thal ba/ dres ma'i thal ba/ phur mong bsregs pa'i thal ba/ lci ba ser kha ma bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams rma khar btab/ shu ba lta bu'i sra cung zad rnyed pa dang*/ tsher sngon/ stag sha tsan+dan dmar po gur gum rnams kyi phye mar dang phag pa'i tshil bu la sbyar te byug rjes nag thig sogs rang gi dri chu dron mos yang yang bkrus pas 'brum rjes dag par 'gyur ro// 'di dag ni bla ma rat+na shrī las brgyud pa'i phyag len te/ rgyas par sman gyi gzhung du zhal 'phangs mdzad pa'i phyir dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel gyi phyogs su bsdur rung ba'i 'brum bu'i sman dpyad kyi man ngag re zhig de tsam mo// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi sgo nas char 'bebs pa'i man ngag ni/ bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ rta'i zla ba'i nya la babs pa'i nyin mo khrus dang gtsang sbra dag pas gso sbyong blangs pa char rdzas chu 'dzin ril bu bsgrub par bya ste/ de la dug rigs med pa'i klu sman bzang po rnyed tshad dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum rnams bag phye dang sbyar nas ra dkar mo dang ba dmar mo'i 'o mas ril bu rgya sran tsam pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tsho ji tsam dgos pa bya/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du mañdzi sogs la ril bu rnams zangs gzhong du blugs la bkod/ mdun du mchod pa bcu gnyis rnams bsham/ sna tshogs yum gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ ril bu rnams kyi steng du sna tshogs yum bskyed la mchod pa dang bstod pas bstod/

gzungs thag dang bcas te rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song*/ mdun bskyed sna tshogs yum gyi thugs ka'i phreṃ gyi mthar sngags phreng bkod pa la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa ril bu rnams la thim/ yang sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten khams kyi sprin thams cad bsdus te ril bu la thim pas ril bu de rnams char gyi rgyun chen po 'bebs pa'i rdzas khyad par can du gyur pa mos te/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ war+ṣaṃ kiñtsi ta nā sha ya nā sha ya/ yul che ge mor

che ge mo'i gnas su yul ming bye brag 'jug ma shes tshe/ char chu mi 'bab pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes 'don/ shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ ci 'grub bzla'o// rjes mchod bstod byas la bcom ldan 'das mas 'jig rten gyi khams su than pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing*/ lo tog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod gsol byas la nongs pa bzod par gsol te mdun bskyed gshegs gsol bya/ dge ba bsngos la ril bu la shis brjod me tog 'thor/ nam mkha' mi mthong bar rdza'i bum pa gtsang mar bzhugs su gsol la dmar skyur sogs kyis ma phog par tshags bya'o// dngos gzhi las sbyor gyi dus klu gnas pa'i mtsho dang rdzing bu/ chu mig sogs su phyin te/ bgegs la gtor ma byin la bskrad/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad la klu chen brgyad dang*/ lte bar klu'i gtso bo rgyal ba dang rnam rgyal bskyed la klu mchod dang*/ klu gtor rnams rgyas par byas la char 'bebs pa'i phrin las bcol/ de nas sngar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu brgya rtsa mdun du bzhag la/ ril bu de rnams las klu'i re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas klu'i nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ bde bas tshims pas klu rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga nas na bun langs te nam mkha' thams cad gang ba las char rgyun babs par bsams te/ oṃ nā ga kā la hūm̐/ nā ga li li/ dum pa li li/ nā ga rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la ril bu gcig chu mig nang du bskyur ro// de bzhin du ril bu re la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad tshang ba bgyis te ril bu rnams re re bzhin chu mig tu skyur/ rang sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can rnams kyi than pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs nas bde ba la bkod par bsams te/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa sogs char sngags drag tu bzla'o// mjug tu mchod bstod bzod gsol bsngo smon bya ste/

tshul de lta bus zhi ba'i sgo nas char dbab par bya zhing*/ gal te char ches nas gcod par 'dod na/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ war+ṣa ba hu nā sha ya nā sha ya bi ṣa a mu ka shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas nas nam mkha' la phus 'debs/ sprin gtor ba'i dmigs pa bya'o// sna tshogs yum gyi sgo nas ser ba srung na yungs kar dang sbyin sreg gi thal ba la sngags/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ ka ra kā ka ra kāḥnā sha ya nā sha ya bi shra a mu ka shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas la phus btab/ ser ba byung dus de 'ong ba'i nam mkha' la gtor bas/ rdzas de las me 'bar/ ser ba chur zhu nas rgyun chad par bsam mo// yang ser ba thog mar sa la lhungs pa rnams blangs te sngags btab cing*/ a la thang po a la thang po ser sna ser ba'i gdong la rgyob/ ces drag tu brjod cing 'phangs pas/ ser gdong snga ma rnams log nas phyi ma rnams dang 'khrugs te 'thab cing dbab mkhan rnams yul phyogs gzhan du 'khyams par bsam mo// 'di ni rang la thug pa'i man ngag ste/ ser ba ma thub na bya yi thams cad du ma yin no// 'di'i sgo nas dug dang gza' nad la sogs pa gso bar 'dod na mdun gyi nam mkhar sna tshogs yum bsgoms pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du phreṃ dkar po'i mthar sngags phreng mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā ta/ sar+b+ba byā di nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas pas sngags phreng las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun skya chil li li byung bas/ nad dmigs yod sar babs nas nad thams cad phyir ded par bsams la sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma na sar byugs la phur phur bya zhing res 'ga' phus btab/ gzer nad sogs la rdo grang mo la sngags btab nas gzer mig yod sar glan/ mthar sna tshogs yum rang la thim pas nad kyis mi tshugs par bsgom mo// 'di ni dug dang gza' nad gtso bor smos pa'i khrag mkhris tsha ba sogs la'ang shin tu phan no// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/

gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal dkar po dang 'dab brgyad la tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrāḥphaṭa kyis mdun gyi tshom bu bsang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā nas ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rgya mtsho chen po sogs nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar spyi 'gro bzhin mchod/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed mdzad ma// skye ba dang ni 'jig pa spangs// kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can// sna tshogs yum der la phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin gyis brlab/ oṃ phriṃ bi shwa mā taḥs pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ sogs btags pa'am/ yang na a kā ros phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das// pra phab pa yi rnam pa can// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la nas kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod la gtor ma phul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya/ mthar slob ma'i don du gsol ba btab/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas phyag btsal nas gral tu 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang zab mo zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan bya dam pa'i chos ni gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi nang gi le'u'i lus srung gi skabs su sdig pa'i nad rdo rje'i tsher ma'i gnyen por gsungs pa'i sna tshogs yum gyi rjes gnang sgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams sngon du song nas/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ slob dpon sna tshogs yum du gsal ba la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes bskul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa'i// srid pa'i skyon gyis gos mi 'gyur// phun sum tshogs pa kun gyi gnas// khyod kyi zhabs la skyabs su mchi// zad med 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las// bdag gi skyabs ni gzhan ma mchis// de bas snying rje cher mdzad nas// de ring bdag la sku drin mdzod// lan gsum/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum tha mi dad pa la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar bdun rnam dag bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas sdig pa rnams mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dag pa gsum gyis bdag gi dngos 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do// lan gsum/ nang le'i dbang gi rigs drug gi sdom pa ma bzung yang 'gal ba med/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

de rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po zla 'od lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung po khams dang skye mched/ rnam smin gdos bcas/ mdor na gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi go sar pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid phreṃ dkar po'i 'phro 'du las/ khyed rang rnams sna tshogs yum sku mdog dkar mo nas/ lte bar hoḥzhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sna tshogs yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i lus la mtsho la kha ba babs ba bzhin du sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang mdun bskyed sna tshogs yum gyi sku las kyang*/ de 'dra ba'i sku mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung nas khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa nas ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sna tshogs yum gyi sku sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba la/ slob dpon sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed sna tshogs yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du phreṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las/

sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du phreṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog dkar pos g.yas skor du dang po dam tshig pa'i tshul du 'khod/ gnyis pa ye shes pa'i tshul du thim/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā taḥ badz+ra kāṇ+ḍa kā na nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum bya/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi don du slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar bsgyur nas spyi bor gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod// bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag sna tshogs yum gyi gsung sngags bzla ba la dbang ba yin no// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba la/ slob dpon sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ sna tshogs yum gyi phyag mtshan pad+ma dkar po dang ut+pa la'i sdong bu dang sa bon gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la reg pa dang*/ rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin bdud rtsi lnga'i rnam par zhu nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi thugs ka nas kyang*/

thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo sna tshogs yum gyi sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig chad nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ phriṃ bi shwa nas/ swā hā'i mthar badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥzhes ci rigs brjod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag sna tshogs yum gyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba rdzogs par thob nas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ slob ma 'chad nyan nus pa'i rigs la bla ma brgyud pa bshad pa rnams spyi dang mthun pa'i phyag len gsum sgros ltar shes par bya zhing mtha' gcig tu nges bzung gis dpyad pa mi dgos/ deng sang dbang rjes gnang gang la'ang 'phros don rang gis bshad ma shes nas/ brgyud pa'i phyag len yi ge la gang yod ma gtogs gzhan bya mi rung zhes rdzun gyis bla ma gong ma mang du mkhyen pa rnams la skur pa 'debs par byed kyin snang ngo*// rjes mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ gsol btab/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o// rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o// phra chos bem po'i yul 'das rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya che// srid zhi kun la khyab pa'i sna tshogs zlos gar g.yo ba las// deng 'dir sdig pa'i nad rims tsha gdung kun tu zhi mdzad ma// zla mdzes lha mo'i man ngag rgyud don bzhin du gsal byas pa'i// dri med dge tshogs dung ltar shin tu dkar ba'i 'od zer gyis// 'gro kun yang dag lam zhugs rdo rje nor bu'i khyim thob shog /ces rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum gyi sgrub skor phan bde'i mchog sbyin zhes bya ba 'di ni/

ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bka' stsal nor bu'i phreng ba spyi bos mchod nas/ gangs can bho ṭa'i ku sā li blo gsal bstan skyong gis thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum pa'i nyin sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal dang tshul mtshungs pa dpal zhwa lu ri phug gi sgrub khang rnam grol yang rtser bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
